title: AdvantageScope
description: Configure AdvantageScope's layout to display already-published robot telemetry.

checkpoints.title: Flywheel line graph
checkpoints.description: A Line Graph tab plots FlywheelRPM on its left axis.

checkpoints.title: Locked axis scale
checkpoints.description: The Line Graph's left Y axis is locked to roughly 0-3000.

checkpoints.title: Differentiated flywheel RPM
checkpoints.description: FlywheelRPM also plots on the right axis with the Differentiate filter applied.

checkpoints.title: Game piece discrete field
checkpoints.description: GamePieceLoaded is added to the Line Graph's discrete field.

checkpoints.title: 2D field pose
checkpoints.description: A 2D Field tab plots RobotPose2d on the Evergreen field.

checkpoints.title: 3D field pose
checkpoints.description: A 3D Field tab plots RobotPose3d on the Evergreen field, camera set to Orbit Robot.

checkpoints.title: Swerve tab
checkpoints.description: A Swerve tab plots module states, chassis speeds, and chassis rotation.

checkpoints.title: Tuned flywheel target
checkpoints.description: FlywheelTargetRPM was written from AdvantageScope's Tuning Mode.
